message.content:
在爵士樂界，以下幾位歌手常被視為頂尖代表（按影響力與傳奇程度排序）：

| 歌手 | 主要時期 | 代表作品/風格 |
|------|----------|--------------|
| **Ella Fitzgerald** | 1940s‑1970s | “Summertime”, “Dream a Little Dream of Me” – 樂句即興、完美音色 |
| **Billie Holiday** | 1930s‑1950s | “Strange Fruit”, “God Bless the Child” – 深情、靈魂感 |
| **Sarah Vaughan** | 1950s‑1990s | “Misty”, “Lullaby of Birdland” – 豐富的和聲技巧 |
| **Nina Simone** | 1950s‑2000s | “Feeling Good”, “I Put a Spell on You” – 政治意識與強烈個人風格 |
| **Louis Armstrong** (男) | 1920s‑1960s | “What a Wonderful World”, “Stardust” – 爵士先驅、標誌性嗓音 |

> **備註**：雖然這份名單以歷史影響力為主，但現代也有許多才華橫溢的新星，例如 **Cécile Béatrice**, **Esperanza Spalding** 等。若你想了解更近期或特定子類別（如酷派、融合）的最佳歌手，我可以再提供更具體的建議。
message.reasoning: The user asks "誰是爵士樂中最好的歌手？" which means "Who is the best jazz singer?" They want an answer. We can provide a list of top jazz singers. According to Wikipedia, top 10 jazz singers include Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Sarah Vaughan, etc. Provide a short answer.
